title: Amazon Takes $850 Off 2026 16-Inch MacBook Pro With M5 Max Chip
excerpt: Amazon today introduced the biggest discount yet on one model of the 16-inch MacBook Pro from early 2026. You can get the M5 Max model with 48GB RAM...
content_html:
Amazon today introduced the biggest discount yet on one model of the 16-inch MacBook Pro from early 2026. You can get the M5 Max model with 48GB RAM and a 2TB SSD for $4,149.00, down from $4,999.00.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

This is a massive $850 markdown on the 2026 16-inch MacBook Pro, and the best price we've ever seen on this model of the computer. On Amazon, it's only available in Silver, and there's an estimated delivery date of November 20 for free shipping
